title: Implement a change or feature in a codebase
trigger_text: add a feature, make a code change, or modify behaviour in an existing project
preconditions: the change is understood well enough to state what 'done' looks like

body.instruction: Find the code that owns the behaviour being changed — the files, the entry points, the existing patterns to match
Decide the smallest set of edits that achieves the change and keeps the code consistent with what's around it
Make the edits, matching the surrounding code's style, naming, and error handling
Build, lint, and run the relevant tests; fix what breaks before moving on
Confirm the change does what was asked — exercise it, don't assume

done_criteria: the diff reads like it belongs in this codebase
notes: Match the existing code — do not introduce a new pattern for something the project already has a way of doing.
